features.name: Connect & Collect
features.description: Connect special symbols from reel one to a special position.

features.name: Special reels
features.description: Reel six and parts of reel three show only special symbols.

review:
Pragmatic's Connect and Collect series goes Irish. The whole sixth reel, plus the top and bottom of reel three, show only special symbols – connect matching specials from reel one to a special spot to win that bonus: respins, extra wilds, cash collects or up to 25 free spins.

Minor, Major and Grand jackpots can land on any spin, and pot-of-gold scatters also trigger free spins. 4,454x max, 96.47% RTP. Very different from a standard Irish slot.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
